SELECT
  a.Periods,
  a.CaribbeanNetherlands,
  ROUND(
    b.male_mbo_total * a.level2_tech / NULLIF(a.total_mbo, 0)
  ) AS "Male_MBO_level2_Technology",
  b.male_vo_practical AS "Male_VO_Practical"

  SELECT
    Periods,
    CaribbeanNetherlands,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EducationLevel = 'A041755' AND FieldsOfEducation = 'A009922' THEN MBOstudents_1 ELSE 0 END) AS level2_tech,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EducationLevel = 'T001336' AND FieldsOfEducation = 'T001069' THEN MBOstudents_1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mbo
  FROM "data/en/odata3/84312ENG.parquet"
  WHERE Periods IN ('2018JJ00')
    AND CaribbeanNetherlands IN ('GM9001')
  GROUP BY Periods, CaribbeanNetherlands
) a
JOIN (
  SELECT
    Periods,
    CaribbeanNetherlands,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PupilCharacteristics = 'A049166' AND Gender = '3000' THEN ParticipantsEnStudents_1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_mbo_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PupilCharacteristics = 'A049059' AND Gender = '3000' THEN ParticipantsEnStudents_1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_vo_practical
  FROM "data/en/odata3/84732ENG.parquet"
  WHERE Periods IN ('2018JJ00')
    AND CaribbeanNetherlands IN ('GM9001')
  GROUP BY Periods, CaribbeanNetherlands
) b
  ON a.Periods = b.Periods
  AND a.CaribbeanNetherlands = b.CaribbeanNetherlands;
